summary: Supplied vector reconstructions of the Pacific Great Eastern map mark (the province over PGE on a folded panel): a solid version rebuilt after a green-livery screenshot, the earlier striped version, and the solid mark on its green livery. All three share one set of map and letter paths (see package-README.txt and review/comparison.webp). The PNRA equipment photograph and the Rapido Trains crop of the same mark are kept as downloads.

assets.label: Pacific Great Eastern — Map mark
assets.notes: The province of British Columbia over PGE in italic capitals, on a folded panel. It replaced the caribou on PGE timetables from 1966 and was on equipment around 1970, in outline, solid and striped forms.
assets.fidelityNote: A supplied vector reconstruction, not original artwork: the map and letters are shared paths, placed after a 151 × 167 pixel livery screenshot; no letter was redrawn. A white coastal gap is a separate overlay. The greens (#728B76, #345135) are sampled from the screenshot, not verified paint standards.

assets.label: Pacific Great Eastern — Map mark, white panel
assets.notes: The mark alone on its white folded panel, with no livery ground.
assets.fidelityNote: A supplied vector reconstruction; the map and letters are the shared paths. Black and white are neutral.

assets.label: Pacific Great Eastern — Map mark, striped
assets.notes: The map mark with a striped upper panel and the province and lettering reversed out in white.
assets.fidelityNote: A supplied geometric vector reconstruction, sharing its map and letter paths with the solid version.
